name: South Bank Parklands
description: Iconic riverside parklands in central Brisbane with Streets Beach, gardens and markets.

name: Lamington National Park
description: UNESCO World Heritage rainforest park famed for the Border Track and O'Reilly's treetop walk.

name: Springbrook National Park
description: Gondwana rainforest park with Purling Brook Falls and the Natural Bridge glow-worm cave.

name: Mount Coot-tha Forest
description: Brisbane's largest bushland reserve with lookouts, the Botanic Gardens and mountain-bike trails.

name: Broadwater Parklands
description: Waterfront Gold Coast parklands with lagoons, playgrounds and skate facilities.

name: Daisy Hill Conservation Park
description: Eucalypt forest reserve near Logan, home to the Daisy Hill Koala Centre.

name: New Farm Park
description: Historic riverside park known for its rose garden and jacaranda trees.

name: Roma Street Parkland
description: The world's largest subtropical garden in a city centre, next to Roma Street Station.

name: Karawatha Forest Park
description: Large native bushland reserve on Brisbane's southside with walking and cycling trails.

name: Coombabah Lake Conservation Park
description: Wetlands and mangrove reserve on the Gold Coast Broadwater, popular for birdwatching.
